entry_points.text: Drivers pin to CPU low-priority, honor holdoff, barrier on start, loop until stop tolerating offline. Init rejects concurrent runs, normalizes weights, registers helpers, starts invokers plus optional stats.
Stutter inserts RCU quiescent point then sleeps to global deadline, absorbing shutdown and reporting stall. Helper adds bounded fuzz, marks idle and uses high-resolution timeout.

Syscall and prctl delegate to shared dispatcher; prctl maps strict/filter. User preparation copies classic descriptor, translating compat form if needed, then prepares; copy fault yields fault pointer.

Permit bypasses when checkpoint-suspended with tracing; strict enforces list, filter evaluates rules, dead warns and kills, unknown traps. Strict entry returns when disabled, enforces when strict, faults otherwise.
Notif file offers poll readiness, release cleanup and ioctls for recv/send/valid/flags/addfd with extensible sizing.

exports.text: Forward a routine plus context to masked or all online CPUs, mapping the sync request to an internal wait flag.
Weak arch mitigation hook defaults to no-op; runs on install unless flaws explicitly allowed.
Return current seccomp mode without side effects.

hazards.text: Sync waits deadlock if irqs blocked between queue and IPI; async via shared storage; irqs-off use prone. Missing completion warns once, counts error, leaks descriptor.
Absent filter where expected warns and kills; shared filter read once per call, absence fatal. Install uses release publish; cache index hardened. Concurrency fails toward denial.
Post-interrupt removal and return beyond value/flags unconfirmed. Distress suppresses; interrupted inject observes or unqueues; copy faults restore; detach wakes unavailable.
Unknown modes/outcomes trap or warn and terminate; surviving kill is a defect. Builds without filter support fail install as invalid and trap on evaluation.

invariants.text: Remote is mask∩online-local pruned by predicate; kicks 0/1/many map to none/single/mask IPI. Local runs only with flag and predicate, irqs off. Mask send traces then arch-sends; scratch is per-task or fallback.
One torture type at once under a global mutex; init records type, arms reboot notifier. Helpers start only on positive interval, stop idempotently. Hotplug health needs attempted==successful.

Each iteration picks one weighted primitive with per-mode counters. Teardown stops threads, sync-broadcast drains callbacks, frees lists, classifies result. Shuffle teardown unregisters all, stops shuffler.

Snapshot holds number, arch, six args, IP. Loader rewrites aligned absolute loads and length; only return/ALU/load/store/move/jump pass. Bitmap check hardens index; chain keeps least-permissive action.

Empty parent is universal ancestor; else ancestor lies on predecessor chain. Sync needs peers unconfined or ancestor-confined, else first bad TID. Sync shares head with release, mirrors count, propagates NNP, enables peers.

Prepare rejects empty/oversize programs, needs NNP or admin cap, allocates filter with lock/queue, refcounts at one. Attach sums lengths plus per-filter penalty against path bound; flags select logging/killable/sync.

Probes always cache-allowed. Builder allows only number/arch loads, const returns/branches/masks; other ops disable caching for that number. New map copies predecessor or starts all-allow; bits only clear.
Trap/errno/trace/notif log only when request and admin agree; log/kill use admin alone; allow never logs. Strict allows only read/write/exit/return plus probes; others go dead and die by kill signal.

Dispatcher handles strict/filter install plus action-avail and size queries. Filter install validates flags, allows one listener. Listener gets random id and file; detach wakes pending unavailable and frees.

Errno clamps and suppresses. Trap keeps registers and forces sync signal with detail. Trace needs live tracer; renumbered calls reevaluate. Notif delegates; log/allow continue; kills mark dead and terminate.

Poll reports demand/answer/hangup. Recv publishes one init entry as sent; send stores one answer. Validity needs sent; only sync-wake allowed. Addfd checks size/flags/sent target; sizes report structs; lookup scans list.
Enable tracked by default-false static key. Per-CPU cache holds two pointers; offline cleanup frees and clears slots, always succeeds.

locks.text: SMP needs task context, irqs on outside crash/early-boot; preemption held over select/queue/dispatch, released before sync wait. Torture may hold CPU-read lock, dropping for RPC wait; alloc atomic, failures counted.
Init/cleanup serialize on a global mutex; removal during shutdown delays and fails. Shuffle list work holds its own mutex across traversal and deletion.
Mode query/install need signal lock; install orders mode before atomic mark, mitigates speculation unless allowed. Sync/install add cred-guard mutex, skip exiting threads, abort on group exit.

Notify mutex guards list, states, flags, inject queues; lookup needs it; recv/send/valid/flags/inject/poll/detach hold it, interruptibly if abortable. Held queueing, dropped sleeping. Recv wakes on in/err/hup only.

state_machines.text: Modes start disabled, move once to strict or filter; switching active modes rejected. Strict violations go dead then terminate. Sync promotes disabled peers only. Dead reentry terminates; queries report mode.

Init on creation, visible on queue, sent on handoff, replied on answer/detach; signal returns sent to init. IDs increment per-filter with wrap. Only sent takes answer/inject, once; failed handoff restores init. Wait is interruptible then killable if asked.

structs.text: Filter holds refcounts, flags, cache, predecessor, program, notif ctx, mutex, queue. Channel holds list/counter/flags/next id. Entries hold id/state/status/value/flags/task/data/completion/injects. Exchange is id/pid/data out, id/status/value/continue back; sizes give three.
Addfd request holds file, fds, flags, completion, link and a union for option versus status. Native cache has native plus optional compat bitmaps; fallback holds nothing and always declines.

SECCOMP_ RET_ALLOW/ERRNO/KILL_PROCESS/KILL_THREAD/LOG/TRACE/TRAP/USER_NOTIF; MODE_DEAD/FILTER/STRICT; GET_ACTION_AVAIL/GET_NOTIF_SIZES/SET_MODE_FILTER/SET_MODE_STRICT; IOCTL_NOTIF_ADDFD/SET_FLAGS/ID_VALID/ID_VALID_WRONG_DIR/SEND/RECV; ADDFD_FLAG_SEND/SETFD, USER_NOTIF_FLAG_CONTINUE/FD_SYNC_WAKE_UP; FILTER_FLAG_MASK/NEW_LISTENER/TSYNC/TSYNC_ESRCH/WAIT_KILLABLE_RECV+O_CLOEXEC; LOG_KILL_PROCESS/KILL_THREAD/TRAP/ERRNO/TRACE/LOG/ALLOW/USER_NOTIF, default all-but-ALLOW.
DEAD is FILTER+1. Wrong-dir ioctl is read, index 2, 64-bit. SCS depth two. Logs share a prefix. Path bound is byte allowance over record size.
